tools.name: mcp_digest
tools.description:
Send text and get its sha256 or keccak256 hash as hex. Listed by Moonbeam: nine outside sellers stand behind it, and the best-ranked one answers.

The answer is checked before you pay, so a failed answer is not charged, and it is graded after. One call is 0.0012 USDC, paid with x402 on Base.. 0.0012
